description: Línea 1 del Metro de Panamá S.A.- Ampliación de capacidad de trenes a Agosto 2019 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Metro de Panamá. Informe de proceso de ampliación de trenes de para aumentar la capacidad de 3 a 5 vagones en la Línea 1 del Metro de Panamá. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Metro de Panamá. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2021-11-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
